map.必须带。仅有参数签名会被重放——攻击者截获一次合法请求后可反复提交。做法是加入: Yes, it must. A signature over the parameters alone can be replayed — an attacker who intercepts one legitimate request can resubmit it over and over. The fix is to add a timestamp and a nonce, and have the server check that the timestamp falls inside the permitted window (five minutes, say) and that the nonce has not been seen before.
